summary:
All checks done. Work is complete and uncommitted on `agent/trim-sync`.

## Status: complete

Removed in-app git sync and the release self-update (daily check, auto-update banner, updater) per the owner-approved cut. Plain-folder sync (external git/Syncthing/cloud) stays the story. Nothing committed; `git status` shows only the intended `M`/`D` entries.

## Summary

**Deleted (5 files, ~1870 lines):**
- `src/platform/git.rs` (~770 lines: git binary sync — commit/fetch/merge/push/connect/clone + unit tests)
- `src/platform/update.rs` (~625 lines: curl + GitHub API check, DAY/HOUR cache, macOS hdiutil/ditto + Linux pacman/pkexec appliers, `INKUNO_RELEASES_API` hook, unit tests incl. macOS-only `replace_the_app_from_a_disk_image`)
- `src/shell/sync.rs` (Shell `git_sync`/`git_connect`/`ask_clone`/`clone_to`/`sync_failed`)
- `src/shell/updates.rs` (Shell `check_updates`/`check_now`/`checked`/`install_update`/`toggle_updates`/`render_update_banner`)
- `src/shell/tests/end_to_end/git_sync.rs` (e2e git-sync chapter)

**Changed:**
- `src/platform/mod.rs` — dropped `pub mod git;` / `pub mod update;`
- `src/shell/mod.rs` — dropped `mod sync;` / `mod updates;`, `git, update` from platform use, `syncing`/`sync_broken`/`update`/`updating` fields + inits, `check_updates` startup call
- `src/shell/palette_open.rs` — dropped updates/installable palette wiring, removed `ask_text` (only used by sync), 5 sync/update palette arms → documented no-op (variants live in off-limits `views/palette.rs`, so arms must stay exhaustive)
- `src/shell/render.rs` — dropped `SyncVault` action handler, update-banner row, welcome-screen “Clone a vault…” button
- `src/shell/notes.rs` — kept the plain-folder conflict copy (`Note (conflict DATE).md`) working by moving `conflict_path`/`free_conflict_path` in as private shell helpers (behavior preserved, git dependency gone)
- `src/shell/tests/end_to_end/mod.rs`, `writing.rs`, `window.rs` — removed update-banner/sync-button/update-palette test blocks and the `git_sync` chapter + runner
- `book/src/sync.md`, `book/src/updates.md` — rewritten: sync via your own git/cloud tools, no in-app sync; no update checks/downloads, upgrade manually via `install.md#upgrading`. Filenames kept so `SUMMARY.md` + `mcp/guide.rs` `include_str!` keep working
- Kept untouched per brief: `vault.rs` bref/encre shims, `scripts/release.sh`, `RELEASING.md`, sibling files, `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`

## Verification
- `cargo check --locked`: **could not complete** — gpui 0.2.2's build script fails with `xcrun: error: unable to find utility "metal"`. This box has only CommandLineTools, no Xcode Metal compiler; the failure is environmental and pre-existing (anticipated in the brief). The inkuno crate itself never reaches type-check here.
- In its place: `rustfmt --edition 2024 --check` is clean on all 8 edited `.rs` files (only pre-existing diffs in untouched `benches.rs`/`panes.rs`); exhaustive `grep` sweeps show zero remaining code refs to `platform::git`, `platform::update`, `git_sync`, `check_updates`, `render_update_banner`, `syncing`, etc. outside the REPORT list below (remaining hits are GPUI `entity.update(cx,…)` / `canvas.update` false positives).
- `cargo test` (incl. targeted non-GUI tests): **could not run** — same Metal toolchain gap blocks building the test harness at all.
- Anchor check: new `sync.md` links `vault.md#changes-from-other-programs` (exists, `vault.md:43`); new `updates.md` links `install.md#upgrading` (exists).

Docs to update (out of scope, now stale/dangling):
- `book/src/shortcuts.md:35-37` — regenerates via `make docs` once keymap rows are removed (generated file, currently consistent)

- Orphaned asset: `book/src/img/git-sync.svg` no longer referenced.
- `RELEASING.md` / `scripts/release.sh`: **no lines invalidated** — verified zero mentions of the in-app updater, banner, GitHub API check, or `INKUNO_RELEASES_API` in either file.
- `INKUNO_RELEASES_API` env hook is gone with `update.rs` (nothing reads it anymore); note for release notes.

## Behavior changes
- No git operations, no clone/connect UI, no update checks/downloads/banner; palette still lists the rows (no-op) until `views/palette.rs` is cleaned.
- External-change conflict copies (`Note (conflict DATE).md`) preserved for plain-folder sync tools.
- `updates=off` setting and the `update` config file are silently ignored (no migration; harmless).

## Open questions
- Should the dead `updates` pref be migrated/removed from `logic/prefs.rs` (integrator follow-up), or kept forever for forward-compat?
- `sync.md` “Limits” section asserts “no sync on quit / phone story” — confirm that matches the owner’s intended messaging.
